description: Show the WORKED STEPS of a calculation, verified step by step: a linear or quadratic equation, a derivative (naming which rule applies), or Gaussian elimination on a linear system row by row. Each step comes with the name of the rule used. When it cannot explain a case it says so (covered: false) instead of inventing a plausible-looking derivation — useful when you have to show your work to a person.

input.description: An equation ("2x + 6 = 0"), an expression to differentiate ("sin(x)*x^2"), or one equation per line for a system

variable.description: The unknown or the variable to differentiate by (guessed if omitted)

name: calc_steps
